notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Silverquill Apprentice triggers, giving a creature you control +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.
